description: This file defines a React context and provider component for handling user authentication within a React application. It manages sessions, provides methods for signing in with email or Google, handles auth state changes, and exposes authentication status and user info to consuming components.

classes.name: AuthContextValue
classes.description: Type defining the structure of the authentication context, including session info, status flags, user data, and auth methods.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component acting as an authentication context provider. Manages session state, initializes auth, and provides auth functions to children components.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom React hook to access the authentication context, throwing an error if used outside an AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook that extracts the user's role from their metadata within the session's user object.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth, maintaining compatibility with existing imports.
